title: The Hard Safehouse
author: Casper Pemberton
blurb: Silas Blackwood, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
